One-shot bootstrap of the live counters for a market upgraded in
place: the counter keys do not exist in pre-upgrade storage, so
decrements would saturate at zero and the counts would under-report
forever. Admin derives the true open totals (a ledger-entry walk of
Position/Order ids \xe2\x80\x94 the same walk the keeper runs) and writes them
here, exactly once. The latch is a DEDICATED marker, NOT the counter
key: closes and liquidations run even while paused and their
saturating decrement CREATES the counter key at zero, which must not
lock the admin out of seeding. Seeding overwrites whatever phantom
value such an early transaction left behind. initialize() sets the
marker, so a freshly deployed market can never be re-seeded.

fields.doc: Hysteresis: the ADL flag clears only once coverage \xe2\x89\xa5 this ratio of\npayable uPnL (bps; must be \xe2\x89\xa5 the trigger ratio) (L0-1).
fields.name: adl_clear_ratio_bps

fields.doc: Optional better-than-mark compensation paid from the buffer to an\nADL'd winner, bps of closed notional (0 = disabled) (L0-1).
fields.name: adl_compensation_bps

fields.doc: ADL trips when payable winner uPnL \xc3\x97 this ratio (bps) exceeds the\npool's coverage (buffer + LP USDC): 12_500 = trigger when coverage\n< 1.25\xc3\x97 payable uPnL (L0-1).
fields.name: adl_trigger_ratio_bps

fields.doc: Base funding rate in basis points per hour
fields.name: base_funding_rate_bps

fields.doc: Base maker fee in basis points (e.g., 2 = 0.02%)\nMaker = limit orders resting on the order book
fields.name: base_maker_fee_bps

fields.doc: Base taker fee in basis points (e.g., 5 = 0.05%)\nTaker = market orders, immediate fills
fields.name: base_taker_fee_bps

fields.doc: Below this share of aggregate MM (bps; 6_667 = 2/3 MM) a cross\naccount is closed out in full instead of staged (L0-5).
fields.name: cross_close_out_bps

fields.doc: Staged cross liquidation stops once equity \xe2\x89\xa5 this share of the\naggregate maintenance margin (bps of MM; 15_000 = 1.5\xc3\x97 MM) (L0-5).
fields.name: cross_liq_restore_target_bps

fields.doc: Share of liquidation proceeds routed to the vault's insurance\nbuffer instead of LP value (bps).
fields.name: insurance_buffer_share_bps

fields.doc: Keeper execution fee: flat base (7-dec USDC) + per-size deci-bps\n(divisor FEE_PRECISION) (L1-21). Defaults keep maker+keeper \xe2\x89\xa4 taker.
fields.name: keeper_fee_base

fields.doc: Max lenient-read clamp vs last-good on settlement, in bps (0 disables)\n(L1-26). Bounds a single deviant print reaching a close/liquidation.
fields.name: lenient_clamp_bps

fields.doc: Liquidation fee in basis points (e.g., 500 = 5%)
fields.name: liquidation_fee_bps

fields.doc: Liquidation penalty as bps of the notional CLOSED in the call\n(L0-4). Charged only on non-bankrupt liquidations; the residual\nequity above the penalty refunds to the trader.
fields.name: liquidation_penalty_bps

fields.doc: Maintenance margin in basis points (e.g., 100 = 1%)
fields.name: maintenance_margin_bps

fields.doc: Maximum leverage allowed (1-10)
fields.name: max_leverage

fields.doc: Maximum allowed oracle deviation in basis points
fields.name: max_oracle_deviation_bps

fields.doc: Maximum position size in USD (7 decimals)
fields.name: max_position_size

fields.doc: Oracle staleness threshold in seconds
fields.name: max_price_staleness

fields.doc: Minimum collateral required to open a position (7 decimals)
fields.name: min_collateral

fields.doc: Flat keeper bounty floor for bankrupt/small liquidations, paid from the\ninsurance buffer (7-dec USDC, 0 disables) (L1-23).
fields.name: min_liq_bounty

fields.doc: Grace period after a partial liquidation during which further\nliquidation of that position is blocked (seconds). Bankruptcy\n(equity <= 0) overrides the grace period.
fields.name: partial_liq_cooldown_secs

fields.doc: Partial liquidation (T3-D4): isolated positions with entry notional\nabove this get a tranche closed first instead of a full liquidation\n(7 decimals). 0 disables partial liquidation entirely.
fields.name: partial_liq_min_notional

fields.doc: Fraction of position size closed per partial-liquidation round (bps).
fields.name: partial_liq_tranche_bps

fields.doc: Keeper's share of the liquidation penalty (bps); the remainder\nfunds the insurance buffer (L0-4).
fields.name: penalty_keeper_share_bps

fields.doc: Trading fee in basis points (e.g., 10 = 0.1%)\nDEPRECATED: Use base_maker_fee_bps / base_taker_fee_bps instead.\nKept for backward compatibility with existing deployments.

fields.doc: L0-9: reject the smoothed mark when the ring's newest entry is older\nthan this many seconds (degrades to spot-only, never blocks).

fields.doc: L0-9: ring entries in the smoothed liquidation/trigger mark.\n0 disables the smoothed leg entirely \xe2\x80\x94 the launch-safe kill switch.

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Per-market risk parameters (L0-12). Stored per asset in market storage
(DataKey::AssetRisk) and read on the hot path \xe2\x80\x94 no cross-contract call.
Invariant mm_bps == im_bps/2 (P5-2), enforced by is_valid() at the
admin setter. The `close_out_bps` and funding/skew fields are consumed
by L0-5 / L0-13 / L0-14 respectively but MUST be in the day-one layout:
Soroban decodes structs by exact field set, so adding a field later
re-bricks every stored entry.
udt_struct_v0.name: AssetRiskParams

fields.doc: Full-close band, bps of notional (< mm_bps) \xe2\x80\x94 consumed by L0-5.
fields.name: close_out_bps

fields.doc: Funding rate ceiling, bps/HOUR \xe2\x80\x94 consumed by L0-13.
fields.name: funding_clamp_bps

fields.doc: Initial margin, bps of notional (400 = 4% = 25x implied).
fields.name: im_bps

fields.doc: Funding velocity ceiling, bps/DAY \xe2\x80\x94 consumed by L0-13.
fields.name: max_funding_velocity_bps

fields.doc: Explicit leverage cap; may sit BELOW 10000/im_bps (launch policy).
fields.name: max_leverage

fields.doc: Max position size, 7-decimal USD notional.
fields.name: max_position_size

fields.doc: Maintenance margin, bps; invariant mm == im/2.
fields.name: mm_bps

fields.doc: SIP-279 skew scale, 7-decimal USD notional (\xe2\x89\x88 2\xc3\x97 the OI cap) \xe2\x80\x94 L0-13.
fields.name: skew_scale

fields.doc: Total balance in cross-margin pool (7 decimals)
fields.name: balance

fields.doc: Account equity = balance + sum(unrealized PnL) - sum(funding) (7 decimals)
fields.name: equity

fields.doc: Free margin available = equity - used_margin (7 decimals)
fields.name: free_margin

fields.doc: Margin ratio = equity / used_margin * 10000 (basis points)
fields.name: margin_ratio_bps

fields.doc: Number of open cross-margin positions
fields.name: position_count

fields.doc: Total initial margin used by cross positions (7 decimals)
fields.name: used_margin

cases.doc: An open would push the asset's net long-short skew past its cap and\nmake it MORE imbalanced (L0-14). Skew-reducing opens always pass.

cases.doc:
Full-freeze pause (mode 2): even risk-reducing ops \xe2\x80\x94 closes,
liquidations, cross deposits/withdrawals, stops, funding \xe2\x80\x94 are halted
symmetrically (L0-15). Only cancel_order works; auto-degrades to
halt-open (closes/liquidations allowed) after 72h.
cases.name: Frozen

cases.doc:
An open auto-nets to zero or beyond against the trader's opposite
same-asset positions \xe2\x80\x94 gross opposite >= requested size, too many
opposing legs, or a sub-min remainder (L1-3). Reductions and flips
go through the close/reduce-only paths, never a one-tx flip.
cases.name: NetsToZero

cases.doc: Trading in this specific market is temporarily halted by admin (L1-24).\nRisk-increasing paths only \xe2\x80\x94 closing/liquidating a position still works.
cases.name: AssetHalted

cases.doc: LP withdrawal is inside the post-deposit cooldown window (L1-28) \xe2\x80\x94 an\nanti-JIT/NAV-sniping delay after each deposit. Everything else is instant.
cases.name: WithdrawCooldownActive
